test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49a8658d2d43c6559c1329c7bb24efbaefe04d1d0beabcc39c20d12c088a376c.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately center left element and center right element interchange positions.
 
• Alternately top right corner element, center element and bottom left corner shifts in the downward anti-clockwise direction. 
 
• Alternately bottom center element shifts to top center position and is replaced by new element i.e 'D' is replaced by 'C' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d0fe10d0758cbf49482209fd0aed1fd626e4423a6d7c1f9eb2500c909266e9.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/257391692163c2991adac564002201da096222cbdd2111b76358a629d2c7eba7.png] '.
 
• Alternately top center element shifts to top right corner position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8487f5e30935280ae4fe035b053d50b1d376c21293af43141ffaadd9cfa60ef5.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first element from second column and third column elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately first column elements and bottom two elements of second column shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3771893a542324fab8bbd5500694baf74b3c3edab02cb92119ed03beb27ad140.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74f2452eb107ac00972d7ebb04153d908e2cf039eaf28ab7c74c072c062fec76.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
